crossRefs.note: May Yahweh answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,
Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.
“God will not withdraw his anger. The helpers of Rahab stoop under him.
“I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!
Stop trusting in man, whose breath is in his nostrils; for of what account is he?
Therefore the strength of Pharaoh will be your shame, and the refuge in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.
Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When Yahweh stretches out his hand…
Yahweh says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in man, relies on strength of flesh, and whose heart departs from Yahweh.
Our eyes still fail, looking in vain for our help. In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save.

translations.web: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.
translations.bsb: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.
translations.kjv: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
translations.asv: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.
